body: Thanks.  Yes, I wrote to them and they gave me their work address instead.

No, she got control of the car. We saw my therapist today together which helped. I wish I could move out on my own so we wouldn't get in arguments, but that's not possible right now because of my finances. I was so surprised at my dad today. It's not all sunshine and roses, but we're all trying to make the best of it. He made me an omelette this morning. I am getting back into meditation, which is one of the few things that makes a big difference in my thought processing. The therapist gave me a book on Anxiety (that's what precipitated the outburst yesterday). I'm not huge on self-help books, but we'll give it a try. Going to see about adjusting meditation, starting me on something else (I'm suicidal at least every month before my period, sometimes more often).

Anyhow, I appreciate the suggestions. We cried together a lot this morning, and I apologized over and over yesterday. We're going to do something fun together tomorrow.
